inheritance
------------------------------------------
In the Hindu society, the इन्हेरितन्चे of the property of a dead person has been considered and decided from a religious standpoint. It is the सपिण्ड relationship that clinches the matter. (See SAPIṆḌA for details.) The person who inherits the property is obliged to perform the śrāddha and other obsequial ceremonies regularly. For this he has to set apart, a part of the inherited property (sometimes as much as 50%!).
The धर्मशास्त्रस् contain exhaustive details about this subject. There are different schools of thought also.
